Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Works great for young, dry skin.
Review: I followed the directions, and used a serum before applying. It does move a tiny bit, but if you’re patient and hold it in places it doesn’t stick well, like your eye sockets by your nose, it will eventually do its thing within a short time.The mask is large enough, but still small to where there are gaps of your face that go uncovered. I used the mouth, and eye pieces to cover the tiny areas of my face that the mask didn’t reach. Even overlapping the mask, my skin still absorbed everything. I have sensitive, and dry skin with semi-large pores. There is a distinct smell, but it didn’t bother me or my skin at all. When applying, the mask will be surprising more slippery coming from the package than when placing on your face. You do need to be careful with the mask, because it can be easily punctured or ripped if you are too rough trying to get it to reach beyond its limits. However, it easily goes back to its form if you don’t completely rip it, so just be careful. Punctures aren’t the end of the world and don’t change the efficiency of the mask.After taking it off the next morning, I did see the difference between the skin on my face the mask reached, to the skin it didn’t. The mask made my skin hydrated, and softened my tired eye bags along with other tiny lines on my face. As other reviewers have mentioned, it does leave your skin shiny yet feeling sticky. I just splashed my face with water to make it less sticky from the mask residue, and that was enough for me to feel okay.Overall, I recommend for occasional use, not daily or even weekly at their price point. There are other products that will absorb collagen into your skin much better, and cover your whole face without taking hours. However, if you have a special next-day occasion, or just want to pamper yourself because your skin needs the extra hydration, I do recommend mixing these in with your routine.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Highly Recommend and a Re-buy for me
Review: I saw so much hype over these masks and similar versions that it was hard to believe they could live up to the rave reviews.But I have to say, these masks are really lovely. Not only do they leave my skin hydrated and smooth, but the experience using them is so enjoyable.Highlights:-no off-putting scent-plenty of serum (I apply the excess from the packaging to my neck and chest)-easy to apply-stays in place-noticeable results-comfortable to sleep in-feels cooling on the skin (even long after application)Con (only one):-tears easily, so handle carefullyYou can wear these overnight or for several hours during the day. Unless you move a ton in your sleep, you can sleep in these masks easily and they’ll stay in place.The cooling sensation when you wear this mask is incredibly soothing. I tried popping it in the refrigerator and that further elevated the experience.I highly recommend these masks. They’re a re-buy for me, and I suggest them to all of my friends and family.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Amazing- best mask I’ve ever used.
Review: Yes!!! Finally a mask that I can feel and see working, and with results that last. I have sensitive dry skin, live in a very dry climate, and even with drinking insane amounts of water and using a humidifier- my skin never feels hydrated. I used ONE of these masks so far 4 days ago and my skin still feels hydrated and soft. Initially I thought I’d have to use another one right away to give myself a hydrating boost but I truly think one a week will be enough.They’re thick; fit is a little off and you might have to adjust it to your face; no excess “tonic” in package but be sure to layer or use the eyes/mouth cut outs. I didn’t notice any weird smells, or tingling like I have with other masks. Glad I added this to my subscriptions because I will be using these weekly until further notice.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Ok update-I decided to just go full boar with this and did all 4 masks in 1 week.I slept with them all night (or as long as they would stay on my face) and after the third, I am seeing the results. Just like with anything, it has to get into your system before you start really getting the effects.This raised it up to a 4 star. Reason it’s not 5 is the mask size. I really don’t think I have a large face but the mask does not fit well. I have to modify it quite a bit to get the coverage I need. The eye area is the worst and needs some improvement.First of all, be careful removing this from the package. It is very delicate and you can puncture the mask very easily, especially those with nails.The mask feels like a very thin piece of gelatinous calamari. The time the mask takes to hydrate is definitely awhile which gives the skins a lot of time to absorb the product. Overnight is best if you can sleep comfortably with it.Does it make you look like you have poreless wet plastic skin like the adverts show on social media? The short answer is no. That would require injections from a medical spa. This is not a quick fix product by any means. But it does hydrate your skin. Once the mask is clear like Saran Wrap on your skin and it is removed, there is a (not pleasing) residue that is left behind. Your fingers do not glide smoothly across the skin like you just put a serum on it. It’s like a tacky feeling like wet glue. But after you wash this off, your skin should feel pretty smooth. But the advertised product videos the influencers are doing are definitely misleading. I’m not saying this product doesn’t hydrate the skin, but I have bought way cheaper face masks on Amazon that do a better job that you do not have to leave on all night.But it was fun to see the hype.1 star for product longevity1 star for appearanceThe mask is not a 1 size fits all by any means. Without the little extra pieces of mask, it would not cover my face.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I saw a bunch of ads for this on instagram. I am always a little skeptical of this stuff, but I saw so many ads from many different people that I had to try it for myself! I love it. It made my skin feel amazing. The mask itself is very soothing when you first put it on. It dries clear and it just peels right off in the morning. My skin felt hydrated and fresh and tight. Not tight like it was dry, tight like firmer. And my skin had a glow. The glow doesn’t stay for a week but it does stay for a few days. I feel like the more I use it the better it will get. So glad I tried it. I have a family wedding next weekend and we are all doing the masks the night before. It will be fun and we will all look amazing 💙 highly recommend!!!!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I absolutely love these! Of all of the masks I’ve tried, these are the absolute best! I’m 52, I’ve got a regular skincare routine for my sensitive skin but nothing has ever hydrated my skin like these masks do. My redness from years of acne and fair skin sunburns fades after this mask. My skin literally craves this mask. If I could wear one every night I absolutely would. My skin is so happy and glowy after the mask, and the effect lasts for a few days. I follow it four days later with their deep collagen mask, rotating between these two. I’ve gotten so much elasticity back in my skin since starting these two masks. It’s thick and easy to apply, warms to my skin and stays in place after about thirty minutes. I tried the other big name brand but their masks have Peg-100 and made my skin blotchy. These don’t have that and really soothe any redness on my fair, sensitive skin. They’re so cooling, so hydrating, I just love them. I highly recommend for aging skin!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Love these masks BUT they don’t stay on face easily
Review: These masks are excellent masks for your skin. Great Korean skin care product, my dermatologist did a skin moisturizing tests and this actually does increase your skins moisture levels. Not like other brands that just leave a film on the top to look hydrated. In terms of its effectiveness it really is a 15/10 from me and my dermatologist! It smells neutral, has a good thickness that thins and turns translucent and your skin absorbs the contents. Smooth and jelly like texture. The only downside is it’s recommended to sleep with these masks however they don’t adhere to your face very well. So unless you sleep on your back and stay perfectly still it’s likely to come off. Likewise wearing it in the day is challenging as it’s recommended to wear for about 4 hours. You have to keep your face slightly tilted back and refrain from facial movements. Obviously for such a prolonged time this can be a bit of a challenge. Is it worth some poor sleep, for me, yes. Because despite this, it works incredibly well on the refinement of appearance of your face. Super moisturizing, anti-aging, fine line reducing and poor minimizing with consistent use, for me that’s once a week. I also use aestura atobarrier 365 cream, with a few other products. But these two changed my skin care routine and I have never been happier with the results!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Not ok for super sensitive skin
Review: After seeing this all over social media, I caved and bought the four pack. Full disclosure - I've been trying to ramp up my retinol use so my skin is probably more sensitive than usual but the package said "safe for sensitive skin" so I figured it was fine. The minute I applied the mask on my face it started to burn a little but that subsided after about 5 minutes.  I carefully ensured there were no air bubbles under the mask and all areas were covered.  The upper part of the face mask initially looked like it would be too small but after smoothing it on it fit...in fact, it ended up being a little too large and the edges flipped up into my hairline. I went to bed and other than not being able to sleep on my side, it was actually pretty comfortable. There was a slight cooling effect which I thought it would be nice to wear it during the summer.  The next day, the mask turned clear and my face looked shiny but not that much plumper.  I performed my morning face wash with Cetaphil gentle cleanser and the minute I put on my regular lotions my face started to sting a little and turn pink. During the entire day my face felt a little hot and itchy, similar to the day after getting a mild chemical peel. Today is day 2 after using the Biodance mask and my face feels tight and there are patches of my face that are lightly peeling. I'm pretty sure it's a reaction to the mask and it's just not compatible for my skin.  Maybe if I wasn't using retinols it would be fine but I'd rather stick with my retinol regime.  Last thing worth mentioning...the marketing states the mask turns clear after your skin absorbs the ingredients of the mask but I noticed that the whole mask turns clear no matter if it was touching your skin including the edges that were lying on top of my hair.  So I don't think the mask turning clear is an indication that your skin absorbed all the serum, it's just evaporated.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Wow this is great! And it made my eye wrinkles look better.
Review: Get yourself this product!!! I saw this on some Insta site or two and ordered it because my face has gotten a bit dry and peely from retinoid and other products. It was weird at first and hard to place exactly where I wanted it on my face because it's kinda goopy and slides around. But I was walking around and probably should have sat still while it became more stuck to my skin. I was actually able to go to bed with it still on. In the morning, after peeling it off (feels like a thick, unsticky bandaid), my skin was SO soft and plumper looking AND my wrinkles were definitely less obvious ( I assume from the plumping effect).  If you see my other reviews you'll see that I've tried wrinkle-specific products that simply do not work as advertised and I had not been expecting that bonus effect from this mask product. But I totally realize it's temporary, not a real solution like Retin A type products. I bought more on Amazon prime day at a great deal and will probably make this one my my regular orders on amazon.  Get this product! (I do not get anything for this review, lol)

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I as most others was influenced by viral videos showing the before and after, I’ve never tried gel mask like this before so I was intrigued! I did not have any issues getting the mask out of the package, it comes in two pieces for easier application. I started with the bottom half and made two small incisions in the chin area to make it stick better. I then layered the top half over it and cut around the nose area to fit my facial features better. I like that the eyes and mouth are also included so that you can use it on the gaps, your neck, or wherever else you please. It has this great cooling effect that lasts all the way until it dries down. It sticks to your skin very well and I didn’t have any issues with peeling while asleep. Though I love the glass skin effect after you take the mask off, it kind of felt like my face was sweating when I woke up. I have only used one so far, but plan on using it weekly as a part of my skin care routine. They are pricy, I lucked out and got mine during Prime Days, now that I know they are worth the splurge I will re-purchase again.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I was a little scared to use these as my skin is acne prone, it can be dry but also oily. I kept the first one on for about 4 hours until it turned clear. The next day my skin felt and looked good, kind of firmed up in a good way, and had a nice dewy look, but not overly so. A couple weeks later I used it again but this time left it on all night. I did feel like my skin was extra oily for the next couple days after that. So the next time I again left it on for only 4 hours and my skin felt great again. It has never caused me to break out. It's become kind of a monthly spa day/ treat for myself.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: The product worked. When I peeled it off my face, my face had a stunning glow just like the photos shown in other reviews. What I didn't like was the fact that I had to wear it all night before the mask became clear and ready to be removed. Also, the glow faded once I washed my face. My face was still soft and smooth but without that stunning glow. The instructions never mentioned that you should not wash your face right after use so I'm not sure if I should not have done that. Since my face was washed before applying the mask I could have gone through the day without washing again. I did not know that doing so would affect the glow.  I also used a deep cleanser so that could have caused that result. I will try it again without washing my face afterwards to see if that makes a difference.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I only kept the mask on for a couple of hours but my skin felt very hydrated afterwards. I would say the effects remained for about four days or so. For reference I am 52 years old with slightly dry skin. It is best if you minimize movement for 20-30 minutes to allow the mask to set. I did find that once the mask said a little bit I had to cut in some spots to help to help it lay better. I have already ordered more masks for not only myself, but to give as gifts for Christmas. Definitely recommend.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: My mom who is 84 and doesn't see that well asked me if I had been doing facials because my skin looked really good. I'm 57 btw. I had only done one mask at that point for a little less than 3 hours. I'm a little hesitant about trying to use them while I sleep. I would say it's worth it. I used to have facials religiously and the last time I had one at the salon I spent a ton of money and saw zero difference. These masks you spend not very much money and you see a visible difference. They're from Korea too and not China which I like. K beauty is called K beauty for a reason. Repurchasing.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I’ve been seeing this mask all over social media for some time now & finally decided to buy it. I only gave it 4 stars b/c it’s not as easy to put on as some of these videos show. Mine tore when I took it out of the package & even more as I was putting it on. So be careful if you have long nails. There is no scent. As I was laying in bed I decided to read some more reviews & that’s when I decided to leave it on for 3-4 hours b/c I wanted to see if I’d have a reaction. I was falling asleep so I took it off in the dark & was so tired I didn’t want to get up to look at my skin. In the morning I looked in the mirror & my skin was glowing but not greasy. I did have a bump on the side of my face but I don’t know if it’s from the mask or not.Mask stayed on well after I put it on.Didn’t feel slimy or greasy.Skin looked smooth & hydrated in the a.m.Will try overnight next time.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Ugh, this jelly like mask is ssooo obnoxious. It’s very easy to put your finger through it. Then positioning it takes work. It also dries out around the edges and lifts. I also found myself ripping it off at four hours in irritation. But let me tell you something. This thing is magic. My skin looked fabulous! And I used the little extra cutouts on my eyelids and lips. I know I will reluctantly buy this again.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Texture is fragile so be careful not to tear it if you have nails. Once applied, it shifted slightly for maybe 30 minutes so readjusting was a little irritating but I was awake and moving around. After that, it stayed put! Dried to clear by morning and my skin looked amazing when I woke up! One of the 11 lines between my eyes is pretty deep and it was completely gone. Three hours later, its back but not nearly as deep as usual. I am in my early 40's, I will definitely be repurchasing these for self-care days!!!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Receiving compliments on my skin for the first time in years
Review: I tried this mask on a whim, but after wearing it overnight once a week for two months, I've gotten more compliments on my skin than I have in the past 10 years! I don't know how it works, but I'm going to keep buying it.One note: I'm a side sleeper, so I get in bed and read for about 20 min to let the mask adhere to my skin before I turn over to go to sleep. It doesn't leave a mess on my pillow and it stays on my face all night.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: This is a thicker, jelly like mask (not those paper thin ones that are soaked in serum). It comes in two separate pieces, upper and lower half, which makes it more customizable in terms of fitting your face. You leave it on for a least a few hours (I normally go to bed with mine on and on the middle of the night I’ll wake up to pee or something and take it off then) and it becomes transparent, indicating that all the serum has now been absorbed into your skin. I was a little skeptical at first like how could this really be that different than other sheet masks? But the first time I used it, the next day I noticed the deep wrinkle in my forehead was so much smoother! About a week after using it the first time I also had someone tell me I look refreshed and well rested.. I immediately bought more 😂 There doesn’t seem to be a smell/scent to it and it comes in a pack of 4

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I am not too big on skincare, but I have been following this mask's hype on digital platforms, a couple of months back I ordered since the price tag is not bad. I live in Arizona and it gets really dry here, this mask worked like magic. Helped me combat the dryness. The best part is you don't have to use it daily (unless you want a baby skin), I use it once every week and it keeps my skin plumped the whole week.I take this with me during travel and put it while I am on the plane to not a jetlagged skin after. This review is coming from a toddler mom and a full-time worker so you can imagine how much limited time I have for myself.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Maybe my skin is just alot dryer than everyone else's.  I definitely didn't feel as though I achieved the "glass skin" that others have raved about, but I do see a difference in the undereye area so that's a plus.  I only left the mask on for 4 hours, not overnight so next time I will do that.I will say my skin does feel moisturized and looks plump.I did get all the liquid out of the packaging and made sure to apply it to my skin after removing the mask.  No sticky residue and no unpleasant smell.  Will update after additional use.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: This is my first review ever and I order a disgusting amount of stuff on amazon. My biggest concern is craters for pores, and the first time I used this, I forgot I had an online meeting and I talked the first full hour I had it on. It moved it around a bit and the center most part of my cheeks my by nose were left uncovered (where a great deal of my big pores are). I took the mask off after 3 hours and the pores that were covered were literally 1/3 of the size of the uncovered pores because they were so clear and hydrated. I haven't seen them this small since I was like maybe 12 (and am now 34). My only issue is that I've told myself I'm only allowing myself to wear one once a week instead of living an entire every day life under them. I feel wasteful with the trash at the end, but omg.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Instagram made me buy this. Glad I checked Amazon before buying off an Instagram ad. Saved 50% by buying from Amazon. Same product, same quality. Made in Korea. Mask goes on white, dries clear after about 4 hours. I left my mask on for 13 hours over night. The Instagram and tiktok ads all say "my skin looks like glass after" showing a super shiny appearance. This is just the residue collagen serum from the mask. When you wash your face, this will go away leaving the face soft, but not super shiny. This mask helped my menstrual outbreak on my forehead tremendously! Pack came with 4 masks, I'll be doing this once a week. I put the eye and mouth pieces on my neck and used the left over collagen serum in the package on my hands and neck. Highly recommend.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Did what everyone is talking about
Review: So I decided to hop on the bandwagon and try these masks everyone is talking about.  I have to say that I did notice a difference in my skin. It felt smoother, my pores were visibly smaller and I did experience the 'glass' look to my skin.  Virtually ordorless.  I'm not a fan of how cold it is with application and not sure if it can be warmed under warm water (didn't want to try because i could've ruined the product).  I am satisfied with the results I received!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Need to leave on a long time, no results yet
Review: I've been using this about 3 times a week for about 2 weeks, although the package says you can use it daily. My biggest complaint so far is that you need to leave it on 3-4 hours until the mask goes clear. I don't exactly have 3-4 hours every day where I can just sit around doing nothing. There are mouth and eye holes, but the mask can occasionally slip if you are sitting up straight. The mask consists of a lower and upper part which are put on separately which is also a bit odd.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Use a mask weekly and honestly have no idea if anything is happening but that is ok. This mask is the slipperiest thing I have ever touched but it goes on smooth and actually stays on when you sit up and even walk around. Be careful not to rip it because it is fragile.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Highly Recommend for Facial Moisture, Smoothness and Hydration
Review: It's a must have for me in my skin care rotation!  I honestly don't find it that hard to sleep in since it sticks to your skin and stays pretty well in place.  I definitely notice an increase in hydration in my skin and now require it 2x a week.  I've already sent a recommendation to a number of my friends.  It's not over liquidy, does what it says!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I tried the BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask and overall, it provided fantastic hydration for my skin. I used it overnight, and by morning, my face felt noticeably smoother and more refreshed. The serum dried clear and the elasticity improvement was real! However, the mask itself wasn’t very adjustable, especially for someone with a round face like mine, and I ended up tearing it while trying to fit it properly. If you’re careful during application, it does deliver great results. Just be aware it’s not the most flexible mask, but it’s worth the effort for the hydration boost!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: This product is amazing. I first wash, tone and moisturize my face with Lancôme Génifique face serum. Afterwards, apply the collagen mask overnight. It dissolves into the skin clear after a few hours. My only complaint is the mask shifts after a few hours almost like it shrinks.  It also is  very delicate and rips easily. Other than that you will see an immediate difference. May cause light acne for oily or combination t-zone people.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I don't normally like sheet mask type products. They slide and the product gets into my eyes. This stays where you put it! I used during the day and it was as comfortable as something like this could be. It's also very cooling. The result was awesome, just as advertised. I highly recommend giving this a try. I bought it on sale in the 4 pack. I will be purchasing it again in the larger pack.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Review of BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask: A Luxurious Overnight Hydration Boost
Review: The BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask is an absolute game-changer in my skincare routine. This hydrating overnight hydrogel mask feels incredibly luxurious from the moment you put it on. The mask comes in two pieces—one for the top half of your face and the other for the bottom—which makes it easy to apply and ensures a perfect fit.The mask has a wonderfully soft texture that feels gentle and soothing on the skin. I wear it overnight, and by morning, it dries clear, leaving no residue behind. The real magic, however, is in the results. After using this mask, my face feels plump, deeply hydrated, and revitalized. The difference in my skin is noticeable—my makeup goes on smoother and looks much better after this treatment.If you're looking for a hydrating mask that delivers on its promises, the BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask is definitely worth trying. It’s a luxurious addition to any skincare routine that leaves your skin feeling refreshed and glowing.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: My pore size did shrink and that’s my main goal and concern! It’s easy to use and stick to the face for several hours so nice (even on my boyfriend that has a beard) To have the bouncy effect at it’s most potent I would recommend around 3 to 4 hours more you don’t have the look you see on social media as much.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Everything about this mask it is for me. And this is coming from someone who barely likes the other "clothlike" facemasks. Not that big of a fan. Here's why I do like this one!The smell is not overwhelming, but it does have a scent. (for those of you who are sensitive to smells) I like it, kind of sweet, and not mediciney. The mask does come split in two halves. The top half, from forehead down to the bottom of your nose. The second half, above your top lip to the bottom of your chin.It is kind of slippery and fragile, you can tear it pretty easily, so be careful with your nails. The two eye holes come out as well as the mouth. Which I like to use and place in areas that don't get covered by the mask. (both sides of the nose for me)I've used two masks and am using them weekly. It says you can wear them overnight, but I have been wearing them for about 3 hours and they are just about fully translucent at that time. My skin feels soooo nice and hydrated when done. These are going to be a weekly treat for myself. Get you some!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Review Title: Dry skin! I love it but not sure about using overnight…
Review: This is a full transparent and honest review. Firstly, $20 for four mask is a bit up there, but with a solid framework, I’m not unhappy to pay it. However, I do use these a lot less than what I would typically use a face mask. I have a solid routine for skin care, so I am no stranger to how to use a face mask and how to make sure that it is effectively working for you. a lot of people talked about using this mask overnight and as someone with dry skin, but not to the point where it will peel, I can tell you right now. It will not last overnight.The first time I used it. was right before bed and I went to sleep afterwards. When I woke up, I noticed that my face was very crusty and the morning and that the masked had absorbed everything into my skin, leaving behind the coating where the product was placed on. My skin wasn’t dry, but I noticed it wasn’t as moisturized as if I were to use slugging and my typical serums. It did have a very cooling effect and that’s what I liked and so again I tried to use the product later on. The second time I use the product I put it on this time a little bit before bed and was up for about 3 to 4 hours before I noticed that the mask had completely absorbed into my skin. On the instructions I believe it says that the turnaround time was 3-4 hours indeed.Social media has made this into something that it’s not as I was looking for an overnight mask. As far as the results go, I actually like it. It feels very cooling, it helps when you’re inflamed, it does feel a bit strange to wear and a little hard to put on in the first place, but it feels like a spa for your face. I like how it absorbs, especially for my dry skin but if you’re thinking that you’re going to see results the next day, you honestly don’t. Perhaps at a microscopic level, your face does feel a little bit more moisturized, but if you have a regular skin care foundation that has hyaluronic acid and a slightly thicker moisturizer , you’re not going to feel that big of an impact. Overall, I would say this is a nice treat yourself, but absolutely not need it. If they were cheaper, perhaps I would use more often but once a week or once, every other week would be completely fine for this.I would recommend purchasing a four pack just to kind of see how it feels in your skin. It’s a nice little treat to mimic a spa day!

This chic raved about how beneficial they are to your skin and how there are affordable sheet masks out there. I figured I should try one of the masks my sister gave me and hopefully my skin wouldn't break out or have an allergic reaction bc it's extremely sensitive.First I cleanse my face, pat dry, and wait a few minutes. Then I apply a clay mask that I purchased from Amazon as well. It's like a dead sea mask. After I wear that for 15 minutes, I rinse it completely off, then pat dry again. The sheet masks are stored in my fridge bc I heard that it's good to do so I assume bc it should be more calming to your skin.So the mask is easy to apply. The times I've used it I've made sure I'm laying down so it's more of like a spa treatment and I don't want to deal with it slipping off. It's best to do this when you're winding down at night or whenever you're chillen! The mask stays on for the maximum of 20 minutes. After that, it's moved down to my neck for approximately 10 minutes and then on the upper decolletage region. Right after I move the sheet mask to a different area, I gently pat the excess essence into my skin for all 3 areas. These tips I got from Aja Dang's sheet mask video on YouTube. This tip helps me get an even bigger bang for my buck. There is mild tingling on my face while the mask is on it. I assume this is the essence seeping into my pores.What I've noticed is that my face does look more hydrated and up close some of my pores are not as visible. As as most others have mentioned, my skin does feel soft.More tips I got from Aja Dang: rub the excess eccence any where else on your skin - don't waste! I use this once a week like Aja does. My skin type is sensitive so I will not go on a 7 day sheet mask "challenge" or whatever. The benefits from these masks I can see over a period of days so this pack of 24 will go a long way.

Review: Some are better than others.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I wanted to like this product so bad!!!!! That’s why I’ll give it 3 stars because I’m sure it works for others and doesn’t work for some. After using this I can confirm that I just have sensitive skin. 😭After cleansing my face with a gentle cleanser I took the mask out of the packaging and read the instructions. Separating the mask from the plastic was actually the hardest part. It felt like it could drop out of my hands or slide between my fingers at any moment so I needed to work fast! Putting it on was fun, and it fit to my face well enough.I left it on for about 3 or 4 hours until I could see that most of it had blended and “dissolved” into my skin. I didn’t notice a significant difference, but the next morning I had a cluster of breakouts on my forehead…another cluster of whiteheads on both my cheeks and for a moment I couldn’t figure out why! What had I used that broke me out like that? The new mask I bought that Tik Tok convinced me to get! LolI would love to give this mask another chance because I really do love the concept, but it doesn’t agree with my skin. I wish everyone else luck with it though.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Sensitive Skin? Wear it for less time
Review: It is not often that TikTok trends influence me to buy something, but I LOVE face masks, so I figured I'd give this one a try. I don't consider my skin particularly sensitive, but I have a combination skin type that will occasionally get irritated, like most people.The mask itself felt cool to wear, and the texture was soft and comfortable. The scent is light and not overpowering. I put it on at night before bed and peeled it off in the middle of the night, so I wore it for about 3 to 5 hours.When I got up in the morning, my face felt a little irritated. Over the span of the day, it became more itchy and even a little red. I rinsed my face off a couple of times, and it did not alleviate the itchy feeling. I did not want to use any more products on my skin, just in case it made it worse, so I didn't use soap when rinsing my face. I was itchy for about a day and a half before I rewashed my face with soap and added a different moisturizer.Afterward, my face felt smooth and no longer itchy. My face did feel softer than normal, so that might have been from the facemask.When I peeled it off, the mask was clear and dry. Supposedly the mask "turns clear when your skin absorbs the material", but the mask will turn clear if you leave it out as well, so that talking point I've seen on Tiktok may not be completely accurate. Anything you put on your skin will be absorbed.TL;DR: If you have sensitive skin, or are trying the product for the first time, wear it for the recommended 3 hours or even less, not overnight. My skin was itchy for a day afterward, but now feels soft. I will be trying the mask one more time with less wear time to see if I have the same reaction as when I wore it overnight.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I have seen these masks all over my social media so I decided to try them. 3 or 4 hours is a large commitment of my waking hours, so I went for the overnight treatment. Bear in mind, I am not someone who can sleep on my back. I settled in, scrolling through Facebook, I eventually fell asleep. I did not apparently stay on my back for long, because when I woke up and touched my face, the mask was long gone. I found the bottom half on the floor and couldn't find the top half. I got up walked to the bathroom. Ahhh! Found the top half! South of the border and stuck to my left cheek! The mask did nothing for or to the carpet, but my left cheek was shiny for 2 days. I suppose if it had remained on my face the results would have been the same? I have 3 more masks to test that theory. I will update if I produce a different result on my next 3 attempts.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Overall, this product is overhyped in my opinion and I wouldn't really choose to use it again.Positives:- good coverage - the tiny cut out pieces help to cover bare spaces that the mask itself does not cover- wearing the mask throughout the night helps to lock in product and helps to feel refreshed in the morning- not strong smelling and doesn't smell or feel chemicallyNegatives:- the gel-like texture makes the mask very slippery and you need to be extra careful taking it out of the package especially as mine was folded weirdly- feels moisturizing and sticky once you take off the mask, but product seems to feel like it easily washes off and doesn't actually help retain moisture on the skin

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: The mask is honestly nothing special. I made the mistake of falling for the marketing that it was some unique, innovative type of mask that allowed your skin to absorb more. It's not.It is just a cellulose/gel mask, similar to other brands I have been using for years. The masks don't turn clear because your skin has absorbed all the milky-looking product.The masks turn clear when they DRY OUT after sitting on your face, exposed to air.The Biodance mask is no more effective than any other sheet or gel mask. In fact, these masks are actually somewhat dryer than the other similar masks I have used. My skin was not as hydrated as with those other masks, and I definitely was not left with a glass skin glow.This mask is thicker than the others I have used, hence why it takes 4 hours to dry out. But this seems really just to be part of the marketing hype, and possibly adding to the cost, rather than any beneficial reason.It is more prone to tearing compared to others; I am unsure though whether it's due to the thickness or the particular composition of the mask.I definitely will not purchase these again.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Although I am happy with this product overall, I am upset due to how easy they rip when I was taking out of the package. I am not sure if it was just a defect or not but the first time I tried it on it ripped while taking it out.As far as the the product as a whole, I greatly enjoy it. I feel like it really does the trick and keeps my face nice and hydrated in the morning. It takes longer then other similar products to dry out the mask but leaving it on overnight I don't even tend to realize.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Ok but over hyped I think
Review: It could be just my skin or maybe it’s over hyped but nothing like the videos I’ve seen. It worked better wearing it for the 3-4 hrs vs overnight. After short term wear, my skin did have the glassy look and felt smooth/firm but it only last a few hrs. After wearing over night, the mask and my skin were bone dry. No hydration at all. My skin was firmer but that’s about it. Had to put on moisturizer. Be careful, they rip very easily.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Very thin and tears easily-better masks on the market
Review: This was my 2nd time trying this collagen mask and my disappointment in this particular brand was high. It is very delicate and not easy to readjust without tearing. The "after" results were also disappointing. My skin was "meh" when compared to when I used the Sungboon Editor version, and the mediocre results I experienced with this didn't last as long as Songboon. They are priced similarly, but there's no comparison. Not terrible, but definitely not fantastic.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: As far as moisturizing, it does a good job. Doesn't have a smell to it that I've noticed. It does irritate my skin almost 10 minutes after I apply the mask. I couldn't keep it on for 30 minutes the first time I applied it. The second time, 10 minutes was all I could take. I guess I'll keep looking elsewhere.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I used two of the masks and both times they ripped when I was putting them on.  Very fragile.  I put the mask on after dinner so they would be on for a time before going to bed.  Problem is I brush m teeth before I go to sleep and my mouth is moving and water drips, not good.  The first mask I used the bottom part never got translucent only the top.  The second one must have gotten to close to my eyes and woke up with my eyes hurting.  I still bought another box hoping the benefit is better than the problems.  I was hesitant to wear a mask while sleeping and still don't think it's a good idea.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Ok hydration, but they cause breakouts
Review: These are my least favorite brand. They provide ok hydration but my skin breaks out terribly the next few days after using them. I’ve tried them three times to be sure it wasn’t coincidental. It’s not. I don’t normally breakout like this, and the little bit of hydration you get for a day isn’t worth it.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I got them - but they came out of the package absolutely mangled, I don't know if these are fakes or if they were damaged in transit or defective or what. I sat looking like buffalo bill and I am sure i didn't get the full benefit bc i couldn't even lay it on my face correctly.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: The first one i opened the mask was broken in several pieces and I could not puzzle them to make them work, which is very unfortunate because there are only four in a package.  The second package was fine.  However,  be prepared they are VERY slippery and can tear easily.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review Title: Good concept but not eco friendly
Review: A good concept of overnight sheet masks, especially for people like me who may fall into sleep and forget to take the mask off. But the plastics to keep the mask parts separate are way too much; isn't environmental friendly.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I like the masks, but they do not cover the whole face. When I used them, the front part of my face was covered, but I had to cut up another mask to cover the parts that were not covered.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Review: I have never had breakouts so bad that it scarred until I used this mask. 1st time it did okay. I won’t use the mask again.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I have very dry and sensitive skin, honestly this did not give much hydration. I was expecting this sheet to give plumpy hydrated skin, but my skin became little red and the next day i do not see any difference. Used it for almost 5-6 hrs, alternate days.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: The mask itself was in so many pieces  that I couldnt use it as a mask.  The serum was very nice so just applied it to my face with my hands.  Never have seen that  happen  with other products

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea

There's a slight, cooling, sting at first but melts into your skin within 30 min and adheres to every surface. Waking up the mask is clear, and my skin is SO supple, dewy, and clean. I rinse with water in the morning and my face looks so fresh all day!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Me puse la Mascarilla según las instrucciones preparando mi cara con serum, pero al poco tiempo de ponérmela me dio ardor y la removí inmediatamente, tal vez sea buena pero no lo fue para mí 😓

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I still didn't see big results cuz i used it only once! But as a skin expert this mask should cover the entire chin and neck area and that's how all skin care products should work!! Please consider this as product development!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: Iv used other collagen face products like face wash and moisturizers. Only left mask on for the minimum recommended 3-4hrs. This made my face super soft but caused skin irritation the next day. No swelling or redness but was super itchy and tender. Possibly allergic reaction as I slowly started getting itchy on other areas of my body like head arms back and legs which iv never had happen before. After everything settled 4 days later face is still super soft but has a weird bumpy texture where it did not before.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I liked the feel of this sheet mask. It’s cooling and hydrating. It’s hard to get to stay in place until it really starts to absorb. However, once it’s set, it’s not going anywhere. I’ve only used it 1 time so far so I can’t speak on results. I will say from the first use, my skin did feel more hydrated and had a glow. As an esthetician, I wanted to try the new “viral” mask. I will update this review if I see fit. As for now, I’d say it’s ok.

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: The mask is really challenging to apply and can rip apart easily and stick together.  I did the best I could and covered most of my face before bed.  After my morning shower, my skin looked amazing!!

Product Name: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, Hydrating Overnight Hydrogel Mask, Pore Minimizing, Elasticity Improvement, 34g x4ea
Review: I think this is a very good mask but it's more of a hydrator as a good serum. There is no need to leave this on overnight. A couple hours is more than enough for your skin to absorb the serum.

Review: I don't see the hype. I have tried many different brands and I wanted to try this one because they are cheaper and have lots of great reviews.  Well....I don't care for these at all. Again, this is just my experience and yours could be different, but I think there's way better facial sheet masks like Maree, Tonymoly, Avatara, and more.

Review Title: You get what you pay for
Review: After using them for a while I can definitely say they are not worth your time. These face masks are really just a fancy gel that occasionally has a smell. The only one so far that does not have a smell is the collagen one; they don't smell bad- it's the product itself that's not so good.*The face sheet itself is extremely itchy and uncomfortable.* None of them stay in place on my face. They feel very slimy and almost glue-like when applying onto my face.The entire area of the mask around the nose is hard to maneuver properly: it's built for people with small noses. That's partially due to my facial structure- I have a bigger nose with a smaller bridge (it's very hard to find glasses that fit) & my eyes are closer together as well, which is why I gave these 2 stars because obviously they won't fit my exact facial structure- duh.The product itself feels drying, slimy, and itchy at the same time. It's so nauseating- and I'm open to experiencing new sensory experiences most of the time. It folds in on itself very easily and it's hard to separate.If you actually get this, it's better to use it like a gel face mask without the cloth. I didn't see any of the effects they described in the variety I purchased- no "refreshing" or "rejuvenating" or whatnot.Additionally, mine came with 3 cactus and 1 chamomile so I was kind of disappointed in that aspect because I was really looking forward to the chamomile one.

Review: I like face masks.  And I love face mask made in Korean even more!  Korean skin care generally seems to work better for me and I see real results.
